suggestions.title: “That takes warmth, and if there isn’t any yet, borrow some.”
suggestions.where: Love doesn’t have to wait for trust, P3

edits.before: Then respond to the complaints that are sure to come. You don't have to accept every conclusion they reach about you, but do listen for the concrete complaint without fighting the yelling and swearing around it, because even if they are coming from a place that is not completely "right," there will likely be something true in what they are saying. If it's something serious, answer it seriously. Do what you can to show your love for them. This might include some or all of the following: Learning to listen to them when they are angry without hitting back. Owning what was not okay. Working on changing yourself so that you are less likely to turn on them. Finding other ways to make up to them for what you did. Finding other ways to show your love for them (this might include taking care of them, such as by buying and cooking food for them, setting limits for them, taking them to the doctor when they need it, and doing what you said you would do). Just not hitting back is enough to start being the adult, even if it isn't enough yet for them to trust you. That takes warmth, and if there isn't any yet, borrow some.

suggestions.title: “No warmth today? …”
suggestions.where: The two-hand practice, P3

edits.before: Begin to send love from your heart down to your inner child and just notice what comes up for you. If some comes back up, let it, and send it on down again, so it goes around like a loop. That part's a gift from them, and they don't owe it to you, so if nothing comes back, just keep sending yours. If you feel resistance, just meet it with love. If you feel or see something, just meet that with love as well. No warmth today? Then rest your hands there and notice what you find, no faking required. Let it go back and forth between your heart and your inner child, like a real conversation.
edits.after: Begin to send love from your heart down to your inner child and just notice what comes up for you. If some comes back up, let it, and send it on down again, so it goes around like a loop. That part's a gift from them, and they don't owe it to you, so if nothing comes back, just keep sending yours. If you feel resistance, just meet it with love. If you feel or see something, just meet that with love as well. If you can't find any warmth today, just leave your hands where they are and notice what's there. Don't pretend to feel something you don't. Let it go back and forth between your heart and your inner child, like a real conversation.

suggestions.title: “… ask it what it’s trying to stop, or what it wants.”
suggestions.where: Working with your guards, P3

edits.before: Instead, you might feel numb, cynical, angry, suddenly hungry, like you need to look at your phone, sexually aroused, like you need to make plans, sleepy, dissociated, or you might even think that what you're doing is stupid. Those are not failures. Often what you're experiencing is a very charming guard. It's what protects you when your consciously installed parental Protector isn't functioning, the same as when you were a child. But before you decide where it's coming from, ask it what it's trying to stop, or what it wants. It could also be your inner child, mad that you took so long to come back, or your inherited parent script, or something from earlier today, or a bit of each.
edits.after: Instead, you might feel numb, cynical, angry, suddenly hungry, like you need to look at your phone, sexually aroused, like you need to make plans, sleepy, dissociated, or you might even think that what you're doing is stupid. Those are not failures. Often what you're experiencing is a very charming guard. It's what protects you when your consciously installed parental Protector isn't functioning, the same as when you were a child. It might not be a guard at all, though. Maybe it's your inner child, mad that you took so long to come back. Maybe it's your inherited parent script, or something from earlier today, or a bit of each. So before you decide where it's coming from, ask it what it's trying to stop, or what it wants.

edits.before: Say to the guard, in the same Nurturer voice you meant for your inner child: “I see you. I'm not going to force my way past you. What's going on?” Then wait and listen patiently. edits.after: Talk to the guard the way your Nurturer talks to your inner child: “I see you. I'm not going to force my way past you. What's going on?” Then wait and listen patiently. If nothing comes back, that's okay, you don't need to push for an answer. Later on, you can ask it, “What are you afraid would happen if you stopped protecting me by…?”

suggestions.title: “Bridge words are words like …”
suggestions.where: Pattern 4: Gentle cause-effect bridges, P1

edits.before: Bridge words are words like ‘as, whilst, because, when, after, before, which means’ etc. These are words that link events, which can make something seem like it goes along with or produces the next thing. That doesn't mean it actually does, of course.
edits.after: Bridge words, like ‘as’, ‘whilst’, ‘because’, ‘when’, ‘after’, ‘before’ and ‘which means’, link one event to the next, so the first can seem to come with the second, or even cause it. That doesn't mean it does, of course.

edits.before: Here's an example of some of the overly commanding bridge language many hypnotists will use: “Because I breathe, the trauma leaves.”
edits.after: Lots of hypnotists use them to claim too much, like: “Because I breathe, the trauma leaves.”

suggestions.what: The definition in one sentence (“which can make something seem like it goes along with or produces the next thing” said as “so the first can seem to come with the second, or even cause it”), and “overly commanding bridge language” said as what it does: claims too much.

edits.before: Can my responses lead to pausing or modifying the script, or stopping & coming to full alertness?
Does the hypnotist treat my lack of awareness of what's going on as some kind of proof that the process worked?
edits.after: Then, if you can't tell what's going on, do they take that as proof the process worked? Are they using identity roles, obedience ladders, age regression, or your wish to belong, to get past your adult judgment?

edits.before: Is the hypnotist using identity roles, obedience ladders, age regressions, or desires for/assumptions of belonging to lower my adult self's better judgment?
Keep in mind though, the answer to that last one requires either checking the script first, or explaining what your adult judgement would accept, as the hypnotist can't be expected to know that.
edits.after: Keep in mind though, you can only answer that last one by reading the script first, or by telling them what your adult judgment would accept, since they can't be expected to know that.

edits.before: Are fractionation, cues, or other methods of affecting my memory or modifying my post-session behavior disclosed before they are used?
edits.after: Will they tell you before they use fractionation, cues, or anything else that affects your memory or what you do after the session?

edits.before: Is the hypnotist implicitly turning my bodily sensations into evidence for a prior assumption?
edits.after: Are they quietly turning what you feel in your body into evidence for something they'd already decided?

edits.before: When we're ready to exit hypnosis, will they give me a clear statement that the session has ended, and would I get back my normal waking (and walking) identity? Will I be able to use my critical judgement abilities as before?
edits.after: And when it's time to come out, will they tell you clearly that the session is over, so you get your normal waking (and walking) self back and can think critically again?

edits.before: When any answer to these questions is unclear, beware. Ask for the exact script. If they don't want to give it, change the method, or walk right out that door.
edits.after: If any answer is unclear, be careful. Ask for the exact script. If they don't want to give it, change the method, or walk right out that door.

suggestions.title: “Borrowing them is fine …”
suggestions.where: Appendix G: Altered states, P1

edits.before: I’m not saying you should use substances, but many people have used them when they first did self-hypnosis, contacted their inner child, or talked to their Higher Self. Borrowing them is fine, as long as it’s from someone steady who won’t try to run your trip for you.

suggestions.title: “Now keep your sense of agency during the answer phase.”
suggestions.where: 9. No-trance inner contact, P4

edits.before: Now keep your sense of agency during the answer phase. You might notice an answer popped up, or you might decide you don't know. You can always take a break or rephrase the question. Sometimes you might ask advice from someone else.
edits.after: While you wait for an answer, stay the one who decides. You might notice an answer popped up, or you might decide you don't know. You can always take a break or ask the question a different way. Sometimes you might ask someone else's advice.

edits.before: Keep aware of the subtle inner signal: write whatever you get. It might be a word or sensation. An impulse or objection. Sometimes there's no signal, just silence, itself a kind of signal. Don't jump to interpreting it as validation of some theory.
edits.after: Keep aware of the subtle inner signal: write whatever you get. It might be a word or sensation. An impulse or objection. Sometimes there's no signal, just silence, itself a kind of signal. Don't jump to reading it as proof of some theory.

edits.before: Hand off the role: have your adult self answer that same question in whatever way is appropriate, preferably by writing or doing.
edits.after: Then let your adult self answer the same question, preferably in writing or by doing one practical thing.

edits.before: Integration/exit: reality test the signal you noticed. As part of testing, if it seems appropriate, you can do something simple based on it.
edits.after: To finish, check the signal against reality. If it seems right, part of that check can be doing one simple thing based on it.

edits.before: There's no elaborate exit protocol here since you didn't go into trance. Just close the exercise and carry on with your day.
edits.after: You didn't go into a trance, so there's nothing to come back out of. Just close the exercise and carry on with your day.
